items.title: DK Metcalf: Questionable due to illness
items.text:
Metcalf  is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Buccaneers after missing Friday's practice due to an illness.

items.title: Rico Dowdle: Listed as questionable for Sunday
items.text:
Dowdle (toe) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Buccaneers after being a full participant in practice Thursday and Friday.
